source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-candidate-without-uuid-is-dropped-not-excluded.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: A candidate with no uuid cannot narrow the probe, so it is dropped as `droppedOther` — NOT recorded as an F-DUPE exclusion. With nothing left the reason is the generic `no_candidate_uuid`, which is what distinguishes this from the all-ambiguous case above.
